G2.definition: G1 bytes + one trailing LF; semantically identical (publisher-proven parity)

campaign_preset_names.rule: attempt ids use only [A-Za-z0-9_-], so prod_safe_name leaves these names unchanged

accepted_scripts_inventory.origin: Session 4 closeout: exact pre-harness deployment, re-verified at the 2026-10-06 transfer checkpoint (S4A and S4F closeout inventories are identical)

historical_menu_content_requiring_owner_.note: The accepted inventory (under which Sessions 1-4 ran) contains historical full CPM builds (sfm/mainmenu/SFM_CSP_G*.py, sfm/mainmenu/SFM_Character_Slider_Preset_Tool_*.py) and historical authority/sidecar package copies (sfm/gate_r*_deploy/). They are never invoked by item 8 and are not deleted (design section 4). I8-Preflight lists them and STOPs unless the owner disposition OWNER-1 (ITEM8_RUNBOOK.md section 2) has been recorded.

fixture_document.location: <local SFM sessions folder>/testscripts.dmx (the original qualification document; the operator passes its real path to I8-New, which re-hashes it)
fixture_document.never_saved: The document is never saved during item 8 (answer No to every save prompt).
fixture_document.resolution: Owner decision (2026-10-08): one physical document serves both named fixture contexts; derivative/variant documents (testscripts_*.dmx, f1_r2_normalized_diagnostic_copy.dmx) are not used. Contents verified read-only (temporary copy converted by SFM's dmxconvert): shot10 and shot12 each hold the Krystal triple; shot3 holds exactly foxmccouldwm1 and mia1. Model checksums are not stored in session files; the probe confirms them live.

krystal.changed_state_requirement: the Fit must change assaultsuitbody1 (target snapshot differs); an all-already-matched Fit is INCONCLUSIVE

historical_fit_result.use: explanatory reference only; not demanded if fixture values differ

krystal.scene: Session 1 completion-run Krystal scene (SESSION3_RUNBOOK.md section 3; S4F)
krystal.shot_rule: shot10 is the established Krystal Body/Clothing context; shot12 also holds the triple but is not used

g1_classification.derivation: candidate prod_scope over the 108 recorded literals, real G1 Master published by tools/sfm_master_sidecar (re-derived by test_cpm_item8_probe.py under Python 3.10)

mia.reached_by: with CPM closed after B8, switch the already-open document from shot10 to shot3 (no reopen, no save prompt)

normalizer.project_scope: testscripts.dmx holds 16 film clips; shot3 must be the sole Selected shot, so the Selected shot is a proper subset of the project scope

D_body.save_after_apply: new preset; readback equals the post-Apply snapshot value

planned_values.rule: Operators set values with ordinary SFM slider entry; acceptance compares the recorded snapshots and readbacks (not the nominal targets) and requires each deliberate change to exceed the minimum meaningful change.

static.status: Prepared offline. Values marked OPERATOR PREFLIGHT cannot be established offline and are recorded by I8-New / I8-Preflight and the probe at the start of each attempt.
